author: Electricks94
body:
#### PR description:

The SoAConstMultiView contains a logical error that shines through when using it with more than two views. Hence, it was not noticed in the use cases so far. This PR fixes the logical mistake and extends the existing heterogenious test case to run with more and more views to check the full range of using the SoAConstMultiView with one view up to MaxSize views 

#### PR validation:

checked unit tests
